newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes little changed in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes little changed in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed little changed at 8.2956 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 8.2955 with trading quiet due to a lack of fresh factors in the market, traders said.
The yuan opened slightly higher at 8.2954 and consolidated around 8.2955 for most of the session, hitting a brief intraday high of 8.2905 during midsession and a low of 8.2959 late in trading.
Trading continued to be sluggish with most done at 8.2956, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan was expected to continue to move in the narrow range of 8.2950 and 8.2960 with no fresh factors in the market.
"The yuan faced selling pressure at the topside of 8.2950 which is regarded as the main resistance in the short term," said one dealer.
He added that players had no intention of pushing the yuan much higher because of worries that the central bank would intervene.
A second dealer said that the brief intraday high meant nothing in the context of the extremely stable trading.
He said that he expected the yuan to keep to the same level at about 8.2955 tomorrow.
The yuan closed higher at an intraday high of 7.0150 from 7.0401 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0722 from 1.0717 against the Hong Kong dollar.
